data.body:
Fixes bug B20cfd41344: ddflow bug fixed --landed <sha> crashes with InvalidValue: invalid worktree.base_ref = '--local' (must be a branch name; a value starting with '-' is a CLI flag) before running the pre-fix regression check, so an already-landed fix cannot be closed through --landed. Repro: ddflow bug fixed B-items-tree-rebase-not-recognised --regression-test tests/test_lease_tree_identity.py::test_a_tree_stopped_in_a_rebase_is_still_the_items_tree --landed 6d3bca0ad -> exits with the worktree.base_ref='--local' error (config validation). Workaround: --skip-regression-verify --verify-reason. The --local flag leaks as the base_ref VALUE; likely the ddflow config KEY VALUE --local parsing confusion (see prior config pin disable command correction).

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B20cfd41344 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B20cfd41344 --regression-test <test>` first).
